description:
On 25th October 2026, our Club proudly served as a Platinum Host Club for “Abhinandan,” a celebration and felicitation honouring Dr Bharat Pandya, Rotary International President 2028–29, at Hotel Sahara Star, Mumbai. Our contribution towards the Platinum Host Club charges was ₹1,00,000.

The programme featured inspiring addresses and panel discussions by eminent Rotary leaders, including PRIPs Shekhar Mehta, Kalyan Banerjee and K. R. Ravindran, PRIP Raja Saboo, PRIDs, Rotary International Directors and other distinguished dignitaries. The highlight was the felicitation of Dr Bharat Pandya and his address, “Not Me, WE,” emphasising unity, fellowship and collective service.

Our Club was represented by President Rtn. Amit Gupta, IPP Rtn. Noopur Desai, PDG Rtn. Ajay and Ranju Gupta, Rtn. PP Saurabh Sonawala, and Rtn. PP Rupen and Neha Doshi.
